title: 6 X 50C COINS - ERRORS & VARIANTS
findings: Six 50c coins in hand-labelled 2x2 flips: three 2005 commemorative 50c labelled 'Robe Cud Error' and three Coat of Arms 50c (1979, 1979, 1980) labelled 'Double Bar Variant'. Labels are the vendor's own handwriting; the cud on the robe is not clearly visible at photo resolution and the double bar variant is not verifiable from the photo. Specialist error/variety market exists.
condition: All circulated; the 1979/1980 coins worn and toned, 2005 coins circulated with light wear.
reason: Error and variety 50c coins have a collector market; 1979 and 1980 double bar varieties are listed varieties, but unverified and circulated.
marks_read: Flip labels: 2005 Robe Cud Error x3; 1979 Double Bar Variant x2; 1980 Double Bar Variant
